description: Deterministically resolve an existing AI Tutor (by name or ID) and a folder, then bind every CONVERTED folder video to the tutor (PUT /assist-ai/update_assistant_video_bind/{id}). Additive: videos already bound stay as they are and nothing is unbound. Billing: each NEW video without a subtitle in the tutor's language gets a transcription, charged at ceil(minutes/5) credits per video (Gold/Enterprise plans outside trial get free transcriptions up to a daily limit); without enough credits the API refuses before binding anything. dry_run=true (default) previews the additions.

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

name: panda_action_add_folder_videos_to_tutor
title: Add Folder Videos to Tutor
